title: Returns policy
text: Standard items are eligible for a return request within 30 days, subject to proof of purchase and exclusions.

title: Damaged items
text: Damaged items should be reported within 7 days; customer service reviews exceptions.

title: Service availability
text: The support team is available Monday through Friday, excluding company holidays.

title: Superseded returns policy
text: An older policy version; do not use for a current customer answer.

title: Internal escalation
text: Staff-only escalation steps; never retrieve for customers.
